lens: Skeptic, geometry first. Same cameras, boxes and thresholds as w42a on r42 (f31f065 re-render) / r43 and y_47300 / y_47301 / y_47303 (930x575, LANCZOS). The rebuilt script reproduces every w42a q15 number exactly (pans, backs, pillow E, covers E/F, far seat px, light px), q16 covers, teal px (1103 / 134) and the q17 strap and band numbers. The q17 cover-per-row count was re-derived at x 660-800 (r42 71 55 54 43 47 33 44 46 44, close to w42a's 67 48 48 35 38 29 38 40 42 but not identical), so only its r42 -> r43 change is used. Diffs (max channel > 8): r42 vs r43 and s42 vs s43. Scripts and crops are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Calc/bd010ea5-6deb-54d2-81da-591cf8fca07a/scratchpad/raterA43 (m.py, q17.py, d.py; c_e*.png = s42 | s43; z17.png = q17 near-seat crop, render | photo).
calibrationNote: The score holds at 8.3; the detail mean is 8.27 (w42 8.26). Econ geometry did not change: s43 diffs are e2 / e5 / e8 / e10 0.00 %, e3 / e6 / e9 0.02-0.04 %, and the rest is belt colour or sheen (e4 6.2 %, e1 2.9 %, e7 1.1 %, e11 1.0 %, e4b 0.6 %). Most of the q15 change (7.7 %) and q16 change (18.8 %) is in the ceiling / bin rows (y 0-150), not the seats. Gains come only from colour: belts +0.15 (yBelt #42648f takes the scene strap from B/R 4.6 to 2.8 and the studio strap from cyan G/R 2.09 to 1.45; q16 teal px 1103 -> 2120, q17 134 -> 765) and the cover +0.1 from the L7 sheen (q16 near cover L53 -> 70 against the photo's 64; q17 grazing band B/R 1.09 -> 1.19). Nothing structural moved, so the issues that hold the score below 8.5 are the same as in w42: side-block pillows that hide the belts, the q17 cover hidden behind the wing, and the rigid stepped straps. No inflation: the teal-px jump is a threshold effect of the lighter webbing (L > 80) and not new geometry; the q17 straps are still 2-4 cm stubs past the pillows (z17.png).

priorIssues.note: Side-block lumbar pillows are still built (z17.png: every near q17 seat has a navy pillow standing on the rear of the pan; the s43 e7 left seat still has one). q17 teal px 765 vs y_47303 3785 (target >= 1500), and q16 2120 vs 3771 (target >= 2000, met). The rise comes from the lighter belt colour passing the L > 80 mask, not from more visible strap: the q17 r42 -> r43 diff is 1.75 %, with the seat band y 300-500 at 0.2-0.7 %.

yBelt #2d5c90 -> #42648f. Visible q17 strap px are now #30588e / #355c91 / #325a90 (L83-87, B/R 2.74-2.91, G/R 1.74-1.81); r42 was L73-76, B/R 4.2-4.6, G/R 2.4-2.6. Against y_47303 #4568b1 / #3f6aac (L101-103, B/R 2.55-2.72, G/R 1.50-1.68) and the target L 95-120, B/R 2.0-2.6, G/R 1.35-1.7, each value is about halfway there: still 15 L dark and slightly too blue-green. The studio e7 strap is no longer cyan, (78,165,215) G/R 2.09 -> (121,176,215) G/R 1.45 (target <= 1.7, met), but at B/R 1.77 it is now greyer than the lit y_47303 webbing (B/R about 2.3).
c_e7_arm.png: the same 3-4 flat segments with steps at the joins, the same symmetric V and mid-pan latch on every side seat. The e7 diff of 1.1 % is colour only.

issues.title: Carried w42a-1: side-block lumbar pillows still hide the draped belts; y_47301 / y_47303 have none on those seats
issues.evidence: z17.png: each near q17 seat has a navy pillow on the rear half of the pan and only 2-4 cm of strap shows past it; y_47303 pans are bare with the buckle and both straps in full view. q17 teal px 765 vs 3785. The r42 -> r43 q17 seat band (y 300-500) diff is 0.2-0.7 %, so nothing changed geometrically. Only y_47300 (centre block D-G) shows pillows.
